name: Maintenance help
description: Help mode entries for the Maintenance plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Maintenance
entries.text: How full the VPS is (disk, memory, swap, load), what takes the most space, and clean-up jobs you preview first and then approve on axHub.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Checks server health again straight away: alert levels, swap and the nightly run. The host part re-measures everything every 10 minutes.

entries.title: Preview
entries.text: Shows exactly what the ticked jobs would remove and how much space that frees, plus what is kept and why. Nothing is removed.

entries.title: Send for approval
entries.text: Sends the previewed clean-up to axHub as one held call. Nothing is removed until you approve it there; the VPS checks every item again before removing it.

entries.title: Clean up every night
entries.text: Each night at the set hour, sends the safe clean-up to axHub. It still waits for your approval there. Off by default.

entries.title: Maintenance settings
entries.text: Nightly auto-clean (off by default, safe jobs only, still approved on axHub), the disk and swap alert levels, and how old things must be before a clean-up takes them.

entries.title: Clean up build profiles
entries.text: Checks every build profile and shows a preview: each open build, copied tracker and plan with a verdict (keep, done already, not needed, duplicate, merge), a one-line reason and proof. Nothing changes until you apply it.

entries.title: Basic only
entries.text: Runs the build profile check without AI: exact matches only (merged PRs and branches, ticked steps, the catalog, retired apps, same titles).

entries.title: Apply
entries.text: Applies the ticked items: done → complete with the date and proof, not needed and duplicates → archived (never deleted), merges folded into the older build. Running builds are never touched. Undo is on the run.

entries.title: Undo
entries.text: Puts one build profile clean-up back as it was. Each run can be undone once; a build changed since the run is left as it is and listed.

entries.title: Open
entries.text: Opens a saved build profile clean-up preview so you can untick items and apply it.

entries.title: VPS
entries.text: Everything about the server in one place: live gauges, clean-up, space users, every other VPS tool and build profile clean-up, one tab each.

entries.title: VPS tabs
entries.text: Status shows live gauges, Clean-up previews and sends clean-ups for approval, Space lists the biggest space users, VPS tools gathers every other server feature.

entries.title: Gauge view
entries.text: Radial dials, bars, a compact strip or history sparklines. Your pick is remembered.

entries.title: Read now
entries.text: Reads load, memory, swap and the disks again right away instead of waiting for the next refresh.

entries.title: Open VPS plugin
entries.text: Opens the VPS page on its Status tab.

entries.title: Quick clean-up
entries.text: Opens the Clean-up tab: preview what goes, then send it for approval.

entries.title: Banner widget
entries.text: VPS gauges on the banner: icon only in a heat colour, icon and value, or mini meters. Tap one for every gauge.

entries.title: Heat colours
entries.text: The colours an icon runs through from low to high. Each stop is a theme colour, so a theme can recolour them.

entries.title: Auto-cleanup
entries.text: When the disk passes the threshold the safe jobs are sent to axHub. Nothing is removed until you approve it. Off by default.

steps.say: The top shows how full the server is. Amber or red means it's time to clean up.
Tick the jobs you want, tap Preview to see what goes, then Send for approval and approve it on axHub.
